# Stratos Games

Stratos Games is an indie game studio and a game portal. Play free casual, puzzle, word and party games in your browser, made by the Stratos family and the studio. Humans test, AI builds, games ship.

## Play (free browser games)
- [Snake Ladder](https://stratos.games/play/snake-ladder/):  Made by Saiqul Modi.
- [STRATOS FARM — MY DREAM VILLAGE](https://stratos.games/play/stratos-farm-my-dream-village/): Grow a small neglected farm into a thriving dream village: crops, animals, factories and happy customers. Made by Nikhat Sultana.
- [Chai & Chakkar](https://stratos.games/play/chai-chakkar/): Drop Indian snacks into the dabba, merge two of a kind into a bigger treat, and climb 14 tiers to the Royal Thali before the tilt spills you over. Made by Md. Saiqul Haque Modi.
- [Stratos Drop Zone](https://stratos.games/play/stratos-drop-zone/): Drop onto Vayu Island, loot up and outlast 23 rivals before the Monsoon Wall closes in. Made by Sk Sarfaraj Ali.
- [Stratos 29 Card Game](https://stratos.games/play/stratos-29-card-game/): The classic 29 trick-taking card game: bid, pick a trump and win points with your partner against three AI opponents. Made by Sk Sarfaraj Ali.
- [Zest Strike](https://stratos.games/play/zest-strike/): An always-online fruit shooter: open it and jump into one live arena with everyone playing, no room code. Made by Mohua Liza.
- [CRYSTAL QUEST – THE LOST KINGDOM](https://stratos.games/play/crystal-quest/): A Match-3 fantasy adventure: restore the Lost Kingdom with a short, satisfying daily session. Made by Nikhat Sultana.
- [Ink Velocity](https://stratos.games/play/ink-velocity/): Draw the road and send a red supercar across the Darjeeling hills, under real Kanchenjunga peaks. Made by Mohua Liza.
- [Momo Run](https://stratos.games/play/momo-run/): A 3D endless runner: dash, jump and duck down a cobblestone road, solo or racing up to 3 friends online. Made by Mohua Liza.
- [DOMINO CLASSIC](https://stratos.games/play/domino-classic/): Classic Draw and Block dominoes: play a friend online with a room code, or take on smart computer opponents. Made by Sk Sarfaraj Ali.
- [Toot Raft](https://stratos.games/play/toot-raft/): One pig on a spinning raft, one spiky river, and nothing but toots to steer with. Made by Tamanna Tahseen.
- [MOTO RUSH](https://stratos.games/play/moto-rush/): Race a 3D superbike through traffic, upgrade five bikes and beat three new challenges every day. Made by Sk Sarfaraj Ali.
- [Wordbloom: Word Journey](https://stratos.games/play/wordbloom/): Swipe letters to fill crossword grids across 8 dreamy worlds, from cherry blossoms to a starfall nebula. Made by Mohua Liza.
- [FAILSPAN: Structural Mayhem](https://stratos.games/play/failspan/): Build real-physics bridges in 2D or 3D, from Class 8 to Expert Engineer: answer your class's questions to earn parts, then test the bridge with traffic. Build. Stress. Snap. Made by Md. Saiqul Haque Modi.
- [SkyForge](https://stratos.games/play/skyforge/): A 3D flight simulator on real flight physics: take off, fly and land at 29 real South India airports while you learn the basics pilots train on. Made by Md. Saiqul Haque Modi.
- [Plot Twist: Spot the Drama](https://stratos.games/play/plot-twist/): Spot the differences in soap-opera scenes: weddings, first dates, office meltdowns and more. Made by Mohua Liza.
- [Babel Harbour](https://stratos.games/play/babel-harbour/): A calm daily word puzzle: sort the crates to the dock showing their true meaning and spot the false friends between German, French and English. Made by Sk Sarfaraj Ali.
- [Dino Frontier](https://stratos.games/play/dino-frontier/): Survive the Frontier, discover eggs and evolve your dinosaur along one of three paths. Made by Sk Sarfaraj Ali.
- [Chroma Clash](https://stratos.games/play/chroma-clash/): A funky 3D color-matching card game: play bots, friends on one phone, or friends anywhere online. Made by Mohua Liza.
- [BrainRush Daily](https://stratos.games/play/brainrush-daily/): Three quick brain puzzles every day, plus endless puzzle rounds and 30 levels of Gem Match. No sign-up. Made by Sk Sarfaraj Ali.
- [Aetherhold](https://stratos.games/play/aetherhold/): Build a kingdom on a floating sky island, summon heroes, raise an army and battle through a 30-stage campaign. Made by Mohua Liza.
- [Cargo Climb](https://stratos.games/play/cargo-climb/): A hill-climb driving game where you haul three loose crates over the hills and get paid for every crate that reaches a depot. Made by Mohua Liza.
- [BridgeWorks Campus](https://stratos.games/play/bridgeworks-campus/): Walk the campus road from Class 8 to Expert Engineer: answer your class's questions to earn parts, then build a real-physics bridge and test it with traffic. Made by Md. Saiqul Haque Modi.
- [Ashgrove Extraction](https://stratos.games/play/ashgrove-extraction/): A third-person survival shooter: find Mara in a militia-held town, keep her alive, call for help and reach the evac helicopter. Made by Mohua Liza.
- [Echo Island](https://stratos.games/play/echo-island/): Explore a living island, bond with creatures and rebuild its lost memory, where every choice changes the world. Made by Sarfaraj Ali.
- [Island Match Quest](https://stratos.games/play/island-match-quest/): Flip shells, fruits, gems and more to match pairs, unlock seven islands, and collect every star. Made by Sumaiyah Sultana.
- [Magic Shot](https://stratos.games/play/magic-shot/): A magical liquid-sorting puzzle: pour glowing potions between enchanted bottles until every bottle holds one colour. Made by Mohua Liza.
- [Skyfall Armada](https://stratos.games/play/skyfall-armada/): Command a flying warship, destroy enemy fleets, and rule the skies in fast-paced aerial battles. Made by Shoaibul Hoque.
- [Arrow Rush](https://stratos.games/play/arrow-rush/): Clear every arrow off the board without a collision. 100 classic levels and 10 adventure worlds. Made by Sahariar Mody.

## Coming soon (claimed by family makers)

- [BLOXPLODE](https://stratos.games/games-bloxplode/): Combo block puzzle. Clear lines, chain combos, survive the 10-level Adventure.
